summary: Operator site current: 58 RV sites (51 pull-through), 20/30/50 A full hookups, showers, laundry, wifi, RoverPass booking. RoverPass quotes $47 weekday 30 A (fits 23 ft at sites 29-33) / $50-54 50 A in season; off-season electric/sewer-only $30. Price gate passes. Pin sits north of Bear River Dr in a vacant lot -> ~270 m move to the park loop. Not waterfront stands.
